title: Prefill burst policy: K screen and 5-pair qualification (Qwen3-4B, A100 GPU7)
registered: 2026-10-22 KST, before the K screen and qualification arms

binaries.candidate: riley-phase1-v3 sha256 bfe682f83384090c369836544916c6fd012c86642fa42bfc9c902ec14e2ae60a with native-burst-kK.json (budget 512, chunk 512, buckets to 512, steady budget 256, max decode rows K); fused decode off

k_screen.cells: fixed C16 and C32, 3 fresh pairs each, 64 warm + 192 measured
k_screen.selection_rule: Among K in {8, 10, 12, 14, 16} (8 and 16 from the earlier screen), keep those with median paired throughput change >= -1.0% at both C16 and C32, TPOT p50 change <= +1.5% at both, and fixed C32 ITL p99 <= 27.0 ms (the Phase 0 vLLM level). Pick the one with the lowest fixed C32 TTFT p95. If none qualifies, report and stop before qualification.

qualification.cells: fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32, 5 fresh pairs each, runner order alternation

gate.primary: fixed C32 TTFT p95: median-of-5 paired change <= -10%
gate.throughput_noninferiority: every cell: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= -1.3% (about 1.5x the Phase 0 A/A 97.5% band at C32)
gate.tpot_p50_noninferiority: every cell: median-of-5 paired TPOT p50 change <= +1.5%
gate.tail_bounds: every cell: median-of-5 paired TPOT p99 change <= +10%; fixed C32 candidate ITL p99 median <= 27.0 ms
gate.correctness: native canonical outputs: measured 192/192 in every arm and no cross-concurrency mismatch (baseline and candidate share one canonical set)

qualification.reporting: All pairs and every metric reported; nothing excluded or repeated; vLLM numbers are quoted from Phase 0 for reference only and are not part of the gate
qualification.decision: Gate pass -> recommend the burst flags for the Qwen3-4B native configuration; fail -> keep budget 256 and record the trade-off
